defs.def: to give sb the desire, confidence or enthusiasm to do sth well 激励；鼓舞

ex.s: Best of all, my passion for my hobbies seems to inspire them to be passionate about finding their own.
ex.t: 最棒的是，我对爱好的热情似乎激励他们也热情地去寻找自己的爱好。

ex.s: Scientific research is inspired by an unknown phenomenon.
ex.t: 我正站在车旁，一只蜂鸟飞到我们中间开始悬停。

ex.s: Unsurprisingly, these new concepts inspire us to build new models of the universe.
ex.t: 不足为奇的是，这些新概念激励我们建立新的宇宙模型。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: It inspired many young musicians.
ex.t: 它激励了许多年轻的音乐家。

ex.s: It inspired many young musicians.
ex.t: 它激励了许多年轻的音乐家。

ex.s: “I’m going to inspire so many people,” she said.
ex.t: “我将激励无数人，”她说。

ex.s: “Solar projects need to be good neighbors,” says Jordan Macknick, the head of the Innovative Site Preparation and Impact Reductions on the Environment(InSPIRE)project.
ex.t: "太阳能项目需要做好邻居，"创新场地准备与环境影响力减损（InSPIRE）项目负责人乔丹·麦克尼克说。

ex.s: What does InSPIRE aim to do?
ex.t: InSPIRE的目标是什么？

ex.s: InSPIRE: A Leader in AgricultureD.
ex.t: InSPIRE：农业领域的领导者 D.

ex.s: Similar research has been done to understand the “neuronal fireworks” that occur when we look at inspiring sculptures, attractive faces, impressive dance, etc
ex.t: 类似的研究已被用来理解当我们观看鼓舞人心的雕塑、迷人的面孔、令人印象深刻的舞蹈等时发生的"神经元烟花"。

ex.s: A good thinker is able to inspire other people.
ex.t: 一个好的思考者能够激励其他人。

ex.s: How does Sullivan’s story inspire you?
ex.t: 沙利文的故事如何激励了你？

ex.s: “I've seen those magic moments when children are talking to someone they are inspired by - their eyes are shining and their faces light up,” she said.
ex.t: “我曾见过那些神奇的时刻，当孩子们与激励他们的人交谈时——他们的眼睛闪闪发亮，脸上焕发光彩，”她说。

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s devotion to acting is wonderfully inspiring.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森对表演的投入极其鼓舞人心。

ex.s: It is to inspire people to learn more about water-related problems.
ex.t: 它是为了激励人们更多地了解与水相关的问题。

ex.s: History can inspire us to learn more.
ex.t: 历史可以激励我们学习更多知识。

ex.s: inspire students’ love for politics
ex.t: 激发学生对政治的热爱

ex.s: We are looking for stories to inspire our readers.
ex.t: 我们正在寻找可以激励我们读者的故事。

ex.s: So what is it that inspires us to invent things?
ex.t: 那么是什么激励我们发明东西呢？

ex.s: People have been more inspired by Franklin’s spirit of scientific exploration than by the facts themselves.
ex.t: 人们更多是被富兰克林的科学探索精神所鼓舞，而不是事实本身。

ex.s: How does Ms Young inspire you in her efforts to preserve Chinese Culinary traditions?
ex.t: 杨小姐如何激励你努力保存中国烹饪传统?.

ex.s: （1分）The                 that there is life on other planets in the universe has always inspired scientists to explore the outer space．（  ）
ex.t: 6．（1分）宇宙中其他行星上存在生命这一______一直激励着科学家探索外太空。（ ）

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: Volunteering makes you feel capable and inspires you to make the most of each day.
ex.t: 志愿服务让你感到自己有能力，并激励你充分利用每一天。

ex.s: Does the look inspire you, and make you want to read more?
ex.t: 这个样子会激励你，让你想读更多吗？

defs.def: to give sb the idea for sth, especially sth artistic or that shows imagination 赋予灵感；引起联想；启发思考

ex.s: The Center offers programs designed to challenge and inspire with hands-on tasks and lots of fun.
ex.t: 该中心提供旨在挑战和启发参与者的项目，包含动手任务和许多乐趣。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: Inspired by magical maps in her stories, she wondered: what if we could build a real-world app that helps people explore hidden places in their own cities?
ex.t: 受故事中神奇地图的启发，她想：如果我们能做一个现实世界的应用，帮助人们在自己城市里探索隐藏的地点，会怎样？

ex.s: He was inspired by another veterinarian.
ex.t: 他受到另一位兽医的启发。

ex.s: “They need to be protectors of the land and contribute to the agricultural economy.” InSPIRE is investigating practical approaches to “low-impact” solar development, which focuses on establishing and operating solar farms in a way that is kinder to the land.
ex.t: “它们需要成为土地的保护者，并为农业经济做出贡献。”InSPIRE正在研究“低影响”太阳能开发的实用方案，重点关注以一种对土地更友好的方式建立和运营太阳能农场……

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还帮助唤起一种想在世界有所作为的内在渴望。

ex.s: And hopes this can inspire more thinking on the topic!
ex.t: 并希望这能激发更多关于这个话题的思考！

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: He was inspired by his colleague.
ex.t: 他是受他的同事启发的。

ex.s: improve visual effects               D. inspire the philosophers
ex.t: 改善视觉效果               D. 启发哲学家

ex.s: I must have always known reading was very important because the first memories I have as a child deal with books． There was not one night that I don't remember mom reading me a storybook by my bedside． I was extremely inspired by the elegant way the words sounded．
ex.t: 我一定一直都知道阅读非常重要，因为我童年最早的记忆都与书有关。没有哪个夜晚我不记得妈妈在床边给我读故事书。那些文字优雅的读音极大地启发了我。

ex.s: Magazine articles can provide reluctant readers with a lively, breezy writing style that can inspire them to read more.
ex.t: 杂志文章能以生动、轻松的写作风格为不情愿的读者提供灵感，鼓励他们多阅读。

ex.s: Many inspired people gave him their support.
ex.t: 许多受到启发的人给了他支持。

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一个说法表明，虽然牛顿确实受到一个落下的苹果的启发，但没有证据证明它砸中了他的头。

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

defs.def: to make sb have a particular feeling or emotion 使产生（感觉或情感）
